literature.citation: Jacques Delors Centre (n.d.), The EU's digital and AI omnibus, Jacques Delors Centre, Hertie School
literature.title: The EU's digital and AI omnibus
literature.headline: Presented as technical amendments to cut compliance costs, the package makes substantive changes without a proper assessment of their impact, which could add legal uncertainty and create loopholes.

literature.title: Digital Omnibus proposals: keep protections under GDPR and uphold the AI Act
literature.headline: The changes lack justification and evidence, including an impact assessment under the Commission's own better regulation principles.

literature.headline: The GDPR and AI Act amendments were not part of a prior consultation; input was sought only after the proposals were tabled.
